title: Landing Page Particle Animation Load
description: Verify the hero landing page loads with the particle animation visible and no rendering errors.

steps.description: Navigate to the landing page
Verify the particle animation is rendered and active
Check there are no console errors or performance lags during animation

title: User Authentication via Google Sign-In
description: Verify user can successfully authenticate using Firebase Google Sign-In and access protected routes.

steps.description: On the login page, select Google Sign-In option
Complete Google authentication and consent
User is redirected to the main dashboard
Protected dashboard routes load successfully without authentication errors

title: User Authentication via Email/Password
description: Verify user can authenticate via Firebase with valid email and password and handle invalid credentials gracefully.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid email and password
Click login button
User is redirected to main dashboard
Logout and attempt login with invalid email/password
Login fails and shows relevant error message

title: Protected Routes Authentication Enforcement
description: Confirm that all protected routes require authentication and do not display content when user is not logged in.

steps.description: Attempt to access dashboard route without logging in
Access is denied and user is redirected to login page
Login successfully and access the same route
Dashboard content is fully accessible

title: Theme Toggle Functionality
description: Validate the dual theme toggle between 'Voltrex Protocol' (dark) and 'Café Precision' (light) works without layout or style regressions.

steps.description: Log in and load the dashboard
Toggle the theme switch to 'Café Precision' theme
Verify UI switches to light nature-inspired style with consistent layout
Toggle back to 'Voltrex Protocol' dark theme
Theme switches back with all components styled correctly and no visual artifacts

title: Real-Time Market Ticker Updates
description: Ensure the real-time market ticker correctly displays and updates prices for BTC, ETH, SPX, and major Forex pairs.

steps.description: Login and navigate to dashboard page
Market ticker displays all required symbols
Prices update in real-time at expected intervals without delay

title: Strategy Selection Menu and Agent Profile Display
description: Verify that the dynamic strategy selection menu displays available agent profiles with proper animations and selection functionality.

steps.description: Navigate to the strategy selection menu
Agent profiles show with animated borders and correct details
Select different strategies from the menu
Selected strategy updates the dashboard and strategy context accordingly

title: TradingView Webhook Signal Validation
description: Test that the TradingView webhook API endpoint properly validates secret tokens and rejects unauthorized signals.

steps.description: Send a TradingView signal with correct secret token to webhook endpoint
Signal is accepted and processed
Send a TradingView signal with incorrect or missing secret token
Signal is rejected with unauthorized response and no processing occurs

title: Autonomous Agents Trade Execution with Risk Checks
description: Verify that autonomous trading agents correctly execute trades only after passing risk management constraints enforced by RiskEngine, FrictionSimulator, and RegimeDetector.

steps.description: Trigger a trading signal that passes risk checks
Trade is executed successfully by the agent
Trigger a trading signal that violates risk limits
Trade is blocked and logged as rejected due to risk management

title: Emergency KillSwitch Functionality
description: Test the emergency KillSwitch can be triggered to halt all trading activity and agent execution immediately.

steps.description: Verify trades are being executed in normal operation
Trigger the KillSwitch manually or simulate emergency condition
All trading activity stops immediately and agents cease execution
System state reflects kill switch active with appropriate user notification

title: Trading Journal CRUD Operations
description: Verify that users can create, read, update, and delete journal entries with trade logging and analytics updating accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to the trading journal page
Create a new journal entry with trade details
New entry appears in the journal list
Edit an existing journal entry
Changes are saved and reflected in analytics
Delete a journal entry
Entry is removed from the list and analytics update accordingly

title: Trade Logs Consistency Between SQLite and Firebase
description: Ensure that trade logs persisted locally in SQLite are synchronized accurately with Firebase cloud trade logs without discrepancies.

steps.description: Perform trading activities that generate trade logs
Verify trade logs exist in local SQLite database
Verify corresponding trade logs exist and match in Firebase Realtime Database

title: Post-Trade Grading and Verification Accuracy
description: Validate that The Professor grades trades accurately and The Auditor verifies trade facts correctly with logs created for each.

steps.description: Execute a trade and allow post-trade grading process to run
The Professor produces correct grade scores for the trade
The Auditor verifies the grade and logs verification results

title: Agent Monitoring Dashboard Real-Time Updates and Chat
description: Test the agent monitoring dashboard displays real-time agent state updates and allows chat messaging without errors or data corruption.

steps.description: Login and navigate to agent monitoring dashboard
Agent states update live with no stale or missing data
Send chat messages in the agent chat interface
Messages appear instantly without data loss or duplication for all users

title: Trading Chart Mode and Timeframe Switching
description: Validate that trading charts support switching between candlestick, line, and area modes, with timeframe selection and indicator overlays functioning properly.

steps.description: Access trading chart on dashboard
Switch chart display mode between candlestick, line, and area
Charts update instantly and correctly reflect selected mode
Change timeframe selectors to different intervals
Chart data adjusts to selected timeframe with correct aggregation
Enable and disable various indicator overlays
Indicators are rendered correctly and update with data changes

title: Multi-Agent State Synchronization
description: Verify the system handles simultaneous state updates and synchronization from multiple autonomous agents without data corruption or race conditions.

steps.description: Simulate concurrent agent state updates and trade signals
State synchronization maintains data integrity and no conflicts occur
Agent chat functionality also supports simultaneous users without message loss

title: TradingView Webhook Signal Latency and Throughput
description: Test the webhook endpoint is capable of handling bursts of high-frequency TradingView signals ensuring none are lost or delayed excessively.

steps.description: Send a high volume of valid TradingView signal webhook requests in quick succession
All signals are processed and enqueued without errors
System does not degrade or become unresponsive under load

title: UI Animations and Transitions Smoothness
description: Ensure all UI animations including Framer Motion toggles, animated borders, and transitions perform smoothly with no jank or stuttering on supported devices.

steps.description: Navigate through app sections triggering various animations and transitions
Animations run smoothly at expected frame rates
No visual glitches or layout shifts are observed

title: Local Node.js Strategy Execution Loop
description: Verify that the local Node.js strategy execution loop correctly integrates and aggregates data feeds from Yahoo Finance, Binance, and Finnhub for timely strategy ticks.

steps.description: Start the local strategy execution loop
Data from all fed APIs are ingested and aggregated accurately
Strategies receive consistent tick data for processing

title: Multi-Strategy Compatibility and Configuration
description: Check that users can configure multiple strategies and the system validates agent-strategy compatibility correctly before activation.

steps.description: Navigate to strategy management page
Select and configure a strategy for an agent
System validates and confirms compatibility
Attempt to assign incompatible strategy to agent
Validation error is shown and strategy cannot be applied
